configure_torch_runtime: configure PyTorch runtime settings including seed, threads, numerics, device, and SDPA variant
set_random_seed: set the random number generator seed for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch reproducibility
set_torch_num_threads: set the number of threads used for PyTorch intra-op parallelism
set_sdpa_variant: set the default scaled dot-product attention variant to torch, flash2, flash3, or naive
set_torch_numerics: set CUDA numeric precision settings including TF32 and reduced precision GEMM options
